# Visual reference: analysis of x.ai

`xai-inspired.design.md` is an **unmodified** copy of VoltAgent's analysis of x.ai's visual language,
taken from `github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md` (`design-md/x.ai/DESIGN.md`, commit `f696123`,
2026-09-21; also published at `getdesign.md/x.ai/design-md`). MIT license: see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).

It is a **starting point, not the source**: Micorra's visual language is [`/DESIGN.md`](../../DESIGN.md),
which explains what was taken and what was changed. The analysis is not affiliated with xAI, and
Micorra uses no name, logo or proprietary typeface of that brand.
